name: Shriek
description: The creature lets out a blood-curdling shriek. Every creature within 40 feet that can hear the creature must make a successful DC 12 Constitution saving throw or be frightened until the start of the creature’s next turn. A creature that successfully saves against the shriek is immune to the effect for 24 hours.
